caption.description: Caption text shown for the TikTok video.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the video was created, when available.

url.description: Canonical public TikTok URL for the video.

thumbnailUrl.description: Source-platform CDN thumbnail or cover URL when available. It can expire or be rejected outside the original retrieval context; it is not a SocialFetch-hosted asset.

durationMs.description: Video duration in milliseconds, when available.

pinned.description: Whether the video is pinned on the profile.

isAd.description: Whether TikTok marks the video as an ad.

views.description: View count reported by TikTok for the video.

likes.description: Like count reported by TikTok for the video.

comments.description: Comment count reported by TikTok for the video.

shares.description: Share count reported by TikTok for the video.

saves.description: Save or collection count reported by TikTok for the video.

downloadUrl.description: Source-platform CDN download URL, usually with watermark, when available. It can expire or be rejected outside the original retrieval context; it is not a SocialFetch-hosted asset.

downloadWithoutWatermarkUrl.description: Source-platform CDN download URL without watermark when available. It can expire or be rejected outside the original retrieval context; it is not a SocialFetch-hosted asset. Preferred over the watermarked URL when both are present.

media.description: Download-related media URLs for the video.

details.description: Additional TikTok-native fields for this video (for example author, music, challenges, and full `video` and `statistics` objects). Keys that only duplicate the top-level fields are omitted.

videos.description: TikTok videos in the requested collection. An empty array can mean no public videos in this collection, or other cases—this route has no lookupStatus.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass in the next request when more pages exist; null on the last page.

page.description: Pagination state for the current response.

requestId.description: Unique request identifier for tracing this API call.

version.description: Public API version that served the response.

meta.description: Metadata describing the request and billing outcome.

videos.caption: How often do you reckon they think about the Roman Empire? 🐈‍⬛ One of the most unusual ancient sites in Rome, and it's free to see from the street, a short walk from the Pantheon. 📍 Largo di Torre Argentina, Rome, Italy This sunken square holds the ruins of Pompey's Theatre, where Julius Caesar was assassinated in 44 BC. When it was excavated in 1929, Rome's street cats claimed it, and a volunteer sanctuary has cared for them ever since 1993. Here are 4 tips for visiting: 1. The walkway through the ruins is about 5 euro and rarely has a queue, entry from the stairs by the medieval tower. 2. The cat sanctuary in the corner of the square is free to visit (donations welcome), open most afternoons. 3. Cats are easiest to spot in the morning and late afternoon, they hide from the midday sun. 4. You can distance-adopt one of Caesar's cats online and the sanctuary sends you updates. videos.caption: You can literally be Juliet from Romeo & Juliet 😭 💌 One of the most romantic things you can do in Italy, and almost no one visiting Verona knows it's a thing you can do. 📍 Juliet Club (Club di Giulietta), Verona, Italy Thousands of letters arrive every year addressed to nothing but "Juliet, Verona," and a club of around 50 volunteers answers every single one by hand. It started in the 1930s, when the keeper of Juliet's tomb began writing back as Juliet. Here are 4 tips if you want to be a Secretary of Juliet: 1. Sign up through the Juliet Club website or Airbnb Experiences. A session runs about 60 to 120 minutes (around 30 euro) and you reply to real letters by hand, on official Juliet stationery. 2. The club is on Vicolo Santa Cecilia, a few minutes from Juliet's balcony. The balcony is the tourist trap, this is the real thing. 3. Email ahead, especially off-season (roughly January to March or October to November), when they have the most room for volunteers. 4. Not in Verona? You can still write to Juliet: post a letter to "Juliet, Verona, Italy" and you'll get a reply, though it can take a few months. Send this video to the mio app and it'll save the Juliet Club straight onto your travel map. #JulietClub #Verona #ItalyTravel #romeoandjuliet #eurosummer

videos.caption: The cows of the alps throw a flower parade every september 🐄🌸 One of the most wholesome traditions in Europe, and the festival is completely free to attend. 📍 Désalpe de Charmey, Gruyère region, Switzerland Every summer, Alpine herds spend around four months grazing the high mountain pastures. In late September they parade home through the villages wearing giant handwoven flower headdresses — but only if the whole herd made it through the summer safely. If an animal was lost, the cows come down undecorated, and the whole valley understands. Here are 4 tips for catching a cattle descent: 1. Charmey's Désalpe is one of the biggest, held on the last Saturday of September, with herds parading through the village all day. 2. It's free, with alpine horns, flag throwers, folk bands and around 40 craft stalls. 3. Buy the alpage cheese — it was made up on the mountain during that exact summer. 4. Can't make Charmey? Almabtrieb festivals run across Austria (especially Tyrol) and Switzerland from mid-September to early October. Send this video to the mio app and it'll save the Désalpe de Charmey straight onto your travel map. #Desalpe #eurosummer #SwitzerlandTravel #SwissAlps #switzerlandhike

videos.caption: A whole town of bookshops, ruled by a king who made his horse prime minister 📚👑 One of the best day trips in the UK for book lovers, tucked into the hills on the Wales–England border. 📍 Hay-on-Wye, Powys, Wales Send this video to the mio app and it'll save Hay-on-Wye straight onto your travel map. In the 1960s, bookseller Richard Booth started filling this dying town's empty buildings with secondhand books. On April Fools' Day 1977 he declared Hay an independent kingdom and crowned himself King, with his horse as Prime Minister. Today the town of about 1,500 people holds more than 20 bookshops and an estimated 10 million books. Here are 4 tips for visiting Hay-on-Wye: 1. Start at the castle: the open-air honesty bookshop in the grounds runs day and night. Books are £1 and you leave the money in the box. 2. Richard Booth's Bookshop is the flagship, three floors of books with its own café. 3. Come in late May for the Hay Festival, one of the biggest literary festivals in the world, and book a bed far ahead. 4. It's about 1.5 hours from Cardiff, on the edge of Bannau Brycheiniog (the Brecon Beacons), so pair it with the mountains. #HayOnWye #BookTok #WalesTravel #Bookshops #ukvillage

videos.caption: This mountain was so cut off from the world that people thought dinosaurs might still be living on top of it 🦕 One of the best treks on Earth, on the border of Brazil and Venezuela. 📍 Mount Roraima, Brazil and Venezuela border Its summit is one of the oldest and strangest landscapes on Earth, with black rock carved into towers, fields of quartz crystal, carnivorous plants, and a tiny toad that curls into a ball and bounces off the rocks to escape predators. It's been cut off on top of the cliffs for so long that much of what lives up there exists nowhere else, which is why it inspired Arthur Conan Doyle's The Lost World and the floating mountain in Pixar's Up. Here are 4 tips for visiting Mount Roraima: 1. The standard route is a 6-day guided trek from the village of Paraitepui. The summit is only reachable up one natural rock ramp, and you have to go with a licensed guide. 2. It rains most of the year and the top sits in cloud, so pack for wet and cold even though you're near the equator. 3. The driest months (roughly December to April) give the best chance of clear views from the summit. 4. This is a remote, logistically serious trip. Check current travel advice for the region and book through an established operator well ahead. Send this video to the mio app and it'll save Mount Roraima straight onto your travel map. #MountRoraima #LostWorld #southamericahikes #SouthAmericaTravel
